The corresponding later published schema is https://github.com/TwistedAsylumMC/bpd-fixer/blob/824b89b8602008ea99401b507059fc2f45e08a40/output/json/cerealizer_NetworkItemStackDescriptor___SerializedData.json.

r/26_u3 leaves MolangVariableMap as a title-only local definition; the established packet wire shape is a length-prefixed JSON string. See https://github.com/TwistedAsylumMC/bpd-fixer/blob/824b89b8602008ea99401b507059fc2f45e08a40/output/json/MolangVariableMap.json.
Route r/26_u3's title-only NetworkItemStackDescriptor references to the documented in-memory compatibility schema above.
Route r/26_u3's title-only MolangVariableMap reference to the documented in-memory string schema above.
bpd-fixer: Dynamic ID is present only for dynamic containers and is optional on the wire.

Mojang's r/26_u3 schema marks this ordinal enum's underlying type as object even though the published enum values are indexed 0..2; use the byte-sized ordinal representation until the schema publishes a scalar underlying type. See https://github.com/Mojang/bedrock-protocol-docs/blob/ba81d713aa983bb6bc26fe662a9934c5de1838a5/json/PlayerSkinPacket.json.

The published Prismarine wire enum retains an unnamed value 2 between Swing and WakeUp; Mojang's string list omits that legacy name, so an explicit pinned mapping prevents array-index guessing. See https://github.com/axolotl-stack/axolotl-stack/blob/feat/mojang-docs-protocol-frontend/crates/valentine/bedrock_versions/v1_26_30/src/types.rs.

Color255RGBA is an untagged representational alternation in r/26_u3; there is no wire discriminator in the schema, so keep generation explicit and loud by selecting the fixed four-int representation until Valentine has an untagged-union IR. See https://github.com/Mojang/bedrock-protocol-docs/blob/ba81d713aa983bb6bc26fe662a9934c5de1838a5/json/ClientboundAttributeLayerSyncPacket.json.

r/26_u3 publishes this required dynamic Data Store value without a schema or discriminator. Preserve the field position as an explicit temporary void lowering, with a generator warning and a parity TODO, rather than silently dropping a required field. The Prismarine baseline models the missing DataStorePropertyValue family separately. See https://github.com/Mojang/bedrock-protocol-docs/blob/ba81d713aa983bb6bc26fe662a9934c5de1838a5/json/ClientboundDataStorePacket.json.
